description: App-level capability for desktop: core IPC, dialogs, file IO, store, menu, and webview-window creation. Applies to the main window plus any secondary 'window-*' windows spawned from File -> New Window. Mobile gets a slimmer surface via capabilities/mobile.json. Note that 'core:window:default' grants only the *getter* 'allow-title'; keeping the window title current as the user opens files needs 'allow-set-title', listed explicitly below.
